lines.gurmukhi: ਨਲੵ ਕਵਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਕਚ ਕੰਚਨਾ ਹੁਇ ਚੰਦਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨ ਤਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naly kav paaras paras kach ka(n)chanaa hui cha(n)danaa subaas jaas simarat an tar ||
lines.translation: So speaks NALL the poet: touching the Philosopher's Stone, glass is transformed into gold, and the sandalwood tree imparts its fragrance to other trees; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am transformed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਤ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਹੀ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਪਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ke dekhat duaare kaam krodh hee nivaare jee hau bal bal jaau satigur saache naam par ||3||
lines.translation: Seeing His Door, I am rid of sexual desire and anger. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਦੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj jog takhat deean gur raamadaas ||
lines.translation: Guru Raam Daas was blessed with the Throne of Raja Yoga.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਚੰਦੁ ਜਗਤ ਭਯੋ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਤਾਰਨਿ ਮਨੁਖੵ ਜਨ ਕੀਅਉ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: prathame naanak cha(n)d jagat bhayo aana(n)d taaran manukhy jan keeau pragaas ||
lines.translation: First, Guru Nanak illuminated the world, like the full moon, and filled it with bliss. To carry humanity across, He bestowed His Radiance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਦੀਅਉ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਮਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur a(n)gad deeau nidhaan akath kathaa giaan pa(n)ch bhoot bas keene jamat na traas ||
lines.translation: He blessed Guru Angad with the treasure of spiritual wisdom, and the Unspoken Speech; He overcame the five demons and the fear of the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਤਿ ਅਘਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਗਤੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਜਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur amar guroo sree sat kalijug raakhee pat aghan dekhat gat charan kaval jaas ||
lines.translation: The Great and True Guru, Guru Amar Daas, has preserved honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. Seeing His Lotus Feet, sin and evil are destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਨੵਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਭਯਉ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਦੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh bidh maanyiu man tab hee bhayau prasa(n)n raaj jog takhat deean gur raamadaas ||4||
lines.translation: When His mind was totally satisfied in every way, when He was totally pleased, He bestowed upon Guru Raam Daas the Throne of Raja Yoga. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਡ ॥
lines.transliteration: rad ||
lines.translation: Radd:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਧਾਰੵਿਉ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਵਿਉਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਤੇ ਨੀਰ ਸਰ ਅਵਰ ਅਨਲ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jisahi dhaaryiu dharat ar vium ar pavan te neer sar avar anal anaad keeau ||
lines.translation: He established the earth, the sky and the air, the water of the oceans, fire and food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸਿ ਰਿਖਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੂਰ ਦਿਨਿ ਸੈਲ ਤਰੂਅ ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਦੀਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sas rikh nis soor din sail taroo phal phul deeau ||
lines.translation: He created the moon, the starts and the sun, night and day and mountains; he blessed the trees with flowers and fruits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸਪਤ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਕਿਅ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar sapat samudr ki dhaario tribhavan jaas ||
lines.translation: He created the gods, human beings and the seven seas; He established the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: soee ek naam har naam sat paaio gur amar pragaas ||1||5||
lines.translation: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the Light of the One Name, the True Name of the Lord. ||1||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਚਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਅਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਹਿ ਸੁਣਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kachahu ka(n)chan bhaiau sabad gur sravanahi sunio ||
lines.translation: Glass is transformed into gold, listening to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੁਯਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਿਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh te a(n)mrit huyau naam satigur mukh bhaniau ||
lines.translation: Poison is transformed into ambrosial nectar, speaking the Name of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਉ ਹੋਯਉ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਦਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lohau hoyau laal nadar satigur jad dhaarai ||
lines.translation: Iron is transformed into jewels, when the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਣ ਮਾਣਕ ਕਰੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਹਿਅਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paahan maanak karai giaan gur kahiau beechaarai ||
lines.translation: Stones are transformed into emeralds, when the mortal chants and contemplates the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਠਹੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਖੰਡ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਅਉ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਗਇਅ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaathahu sreekha(n)d satigur keeau dukh daridr tin ke gai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru transforms ordinary wood into sandalwood, eradicating the pains of poverty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਚਰਨ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਪਰੇਤ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਭਇਅ ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: satiguroo charan jinh parasiaa se pas paret sur nar bhai ||2||6||
lines.translation: Whoever touches the Feet of the True Guru, is transformed from a beast and a ghost into an angelic being. ||2||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਧਨਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਾਰਵੁ ਦਿਜਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaam guroo hoi val dhanahi kiaa gaarav dijai ||
lines.translation: One who has the Guru on his side - how could he be proud of his wealth?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਜਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaam guroo hoi val lakh baahe kiaa kijai ||
lines.translation: One who has the Guru on his side - what would hundreds of thousands of supporters do for him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਰੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਨਨ ਪਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaam guroo hoi val giaan ar dhiaan anan par ||
lines.translation: One who has the Guru on his side, does not depend on anyone else for spiritual wisdom and meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਸੁ ਸਚਹ ਘਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaam guroo hoi val sabad saakhee s sachah ghar ||
lines.translation: One who has the Guru on his side contemplates the Shabad and the Teachings, and abides in the Home of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਭਟੁ ਬੇਨਤਿ ਕਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo guroo guroo ahinis japai daas bhat benat kahai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble slave and poet utters this prayer: whoever chants to the Guru night and day,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਧਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹ ਥੇ ਰਹੈ ॥੩॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jo guroo naam rid mahi dharai so janam maran duh the rahai ||3||7||
lines.translation: whoever enshrines the Name of the Guru within his heart, is rid of both birth and death. ||3||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar guroo bin samajh na aavai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, there is utter darkness; without the Guru, understanding does not come.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin surat na sidh guroo bin mukat na paavai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, there is no intuitive awareness or success; without the Guru, there is no liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kar sach beechaar guroo kar re man mere ||
lines.translation: So make Him your Guru, and contemplate the Truth; make Him your Guru, O my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸਪੁੰਨ ਅਘਨ ਕਟਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kar sabad sapu(n)n aghan katahi sabh tere ||
lines.translation: Make Him your Guru, who is embellished and exalted in the Word of the Shabad; all your sins shall be washed away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਯਣਿ ਬਯਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿ ਕਵਿ ਨਲੵ ਕਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur nayan bayan gur gur karahu guroo sat kav naly kahi ||
lines.translation: So speaks NALL the poet: with your eyes, make Him your Guru; with the words you speak, make Him your Guru, your True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਅਉ ਨਹੁ ਕੀਅਉ ਤੇ ਅਕਯਥ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jin guroo na dekhiau nahu keeau te akayath sa(n)saar mahi ||4||8||
lines.translation: Those who have not seen the Guru, who have not made Him their Guru, are useless in this world. ||4||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo guroo gur kar man mere ||
lines.translation: Dwell upon the Guru, the Guru, the Guru, O my mind.
